'''Lord Duen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed near the [[Dark Temple]], he was tasked with recovering artifacts.

==Features==
He had grey hair color and brown eye color. He also had light skin.
